versionDescription: After SEC/CT/FDA/news/USPTO document upserts, write evidence_chunks from existing chunk_text (E7).

parameters.query: INSERT INTO evidence_chunks (evidence_id, chunk_index, chunk_text, token_estimate, metadata_json) VALUES ($1::uuid, COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM($2), ''), 'null')::integer, 0), $3, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM($4), ''), 'null')::integer, convert_from(decode($5, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (evidence_id, chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET chunk_text = EXCLUDED.chunk_text, token_estimate = EXCLUDED.token_estimate, metadata_json = EXCLUDED.metadata_json RETURNING id AS chunk_id, evidence_id
